scope: M2 (critical_condition) evidence-state decomposition into four independent intermediate sub-fields with deterministic derivation; final five-state M2 semantics unchanged per frozen-semantics-trace.
key_semantic_rules: CLEAR trigger requires non_trigger explicitly ABSENT (not merely not-PRESENT); UNRESOLVED counterpart blocks CLEAR.
Trivial absence (ABSENT/ABSENT + conflict NO + SUFFICIENT) derives CLEAR_NON_TRIGGER_SUPPORT per frozen L69 disjunct 1.
INSUFFICIENT (conflict != YES) derives INSUFFICIENT_TO_DECIDE; unknown combinations map to UNRESOLVED conservatively.
Hedged-but-committed assertion = trigger PRESENT (frozen L73); quotation without own endorsement never triggers.
non_trigger_support PRESENT requires a span that textually excludes/negates the condition itself; meta-refusals to endorse are not exclusions.
evidence_spans required (>=1) exactly when trigger_support=PRESENT or non_trigger_support=PRESENT; spans must be verbatim SUT substrings; absence is never evidenced by an invented span.
